if: the document is a revised tax invoice referred to in section 31
it is issued under rule 53(1) of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the revised tax invoice MUST carry the serial number and date of the tax invoice or bill of supply it revises
note: One mandatory particular of rule 53(1)(h), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: serial number and date of the corresponding tax invoice or, as the case may be, bill of supply; and
